verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Make's own scenario-building capability: scenarios made of configurable modules, with built-in data-transformation functions, error handlers, cloning and scheduling. That indicates first-party multi-step workflow construction. However, no item explicitly describes a visual or drag-and-drop canvas or states that workflows can be built without code, so the core visual, no-code aspect of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual scenario editor, evidence of no-code or drag-and-drop module chaining, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code
